description: Probable maximum flood extent - referable dams - Queensland series is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. The datasets in this series describe the Probable Maximum Flood extents below the referable dams of Queensland for three different scenarios. Coverage: Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. It offers 6 resource(s) in REST, SHP, TAB, FGDB, KMZ, GPKG, WMS, XML. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
